findings.title: B2 and C2: T13 applies the C2 adjustment of SPEC 6.4 in site code instead of taking its display records from satakeRecord
findings.claim: The restricted board name and the Bourbaki order that T13 displays are rebuilt in site code from satake(d), with a second copy of the C2 rule. The satakeRecord records that matchCatalogue returns are read only for their names, so the 6.4 naming rule now has two implementations, one outside the engine.
findings.expected: SPEC 6.4: 'This adjustment is made by satake_record (engine: satakeRecord); the plain function satake would say B2.' SPEC Appendix H, Rules (also in CLAUDE.md): 'Satake records for display come from satakeRecord, which applies the C2 naming of SPEC 6.4.'
findings.observed: model.ts:445 `if (r.restricted_type_display === 'C2' && restrictedBoardName === 'B2' && order !== null) {`, 446 `restrictedBoardName = 'C2';`, 447 `order = order.reverse();`, applied to satake(d)'s restricted_board and restricted_orbits_in_bourbaki_order. Every displayed value is right today: called with the reader's own pair, satakeRecord(name, {...record, black_nodes, tau}) gives the same restricted_board and orbits on every catalogue pair and every symmetry image of rank at most 6, so the fix is a call to the engine.
findings.reproduction: From a clean checkout of f07eec6 plus the reproducer: npm ci --prefer-offline; npx vitest run site/tests/unit/redteam-RT-02-p6-c2-once.test.ts. The first test fails and lists model.ts:445, 446 and 447; the second test passes.
findings.specRef: SPEC.md 6.4 'Names in rank 2' ('This adjustment is made by satake_record (engine: satakeRecord)'); Appendix H Rules; RT-02 attack 13. decisions/P6-A3.md records that the plan's instruction 5.6 asked for the site-side adjustment.
findings.proposedFix: In assembleData, take restricted_board and restricted_orbits_in_bourbaki_order from satakeRecord(boardName, {...record, black_nodes: X, tau}) for the reader's own pair, and delete the site branch. The plan directed the current design, so this may need the orchestrator's decision.

findings.title: Position for label: T13 converts the labels of the drawn restricted board to array indices with `l - 1`, `k - 1` and `k + 1` outside toLabels/toPositions
findings.claim: T13 turns a node label of the drawn restricted board (boardFromName of the restricted board's name) into an index of the Bourbaki-ordered arrays (drawing.orbits, pairs, orbitIndex, coordinates) by subtracting one, and writes labels back by adding one, in 12 places. RestrictedBoardView.svelte converts the same labels with toLabels and toPositions.
findings.expected: SPEC 5.1 E-7: 'Two functions, toLabels and toPositions, convert node lists and words; nothing else converts.'
findings.observed: Twelve lines, for example `drawn.labels.map((l) => String(coords[l - 1]!))`, `drawing.orbitIndex[k - 1]` and `${k + 1}: (${a}, ${b})`. Every value is right, because every drawn restricted board is a named finite board whose labels are 1..m in position order. Lens section 6 rates such a conversion minor.
findings.reproduction: From a clean checkout of f07eec6 plus the reproducer: npm ci --prefer-offline; npx vitest run site/tests/unit/redteam-RT-02-p6-label-arith.test.ts. One test fails and lists the 12 lines.
findings.specRef: SPEC.md 5.1 E-7 ('nothing else converts'); RT-02 attack 1 and section 6.
findings.proposedFix: Index the Bourbaki-ordered arrays by toPositions(drawn, [l])[0], and write the drawn node's label with toLabels(drawn, [k])[0].
